decisions.briefing: NASDAQ +1.2% and S&P 500 +0.7% confirm a genuine risk-on day, so we deployed idle cash into our three open slots. Picked NVDA, APLD, and BE — all showing full bullish confirmation (MACD crossover, rising histogram, RSI in the healthy 55-70 zone, price above SMA-20) while avoiding over-concentration in bitcoin-miner names like WULF/MARA that already dominate the top of the screen.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices pushed higher today with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500, consistent with continued risk appetite for growth and tech-adjacent names. Breadth was healthy, with numerous momentum names showing synchronized bullish signals (MACD crossovers, rising histograms, prices above their 20-day averages) rather than a narrow rally. No single catalyst headline was available today, but the pattern points to broad-based buying rather than a one-stock story.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍走高，納斯達克指數升幅跑贏標普500指數，顯示市場對科技及成長股的risk appetite持續升溫。市場廣度良好，多隻動能股同步出現看漲訊號（MACD黃金交叉、動能柱狀圖上升、股價站上20日均線），反映這是一次較全面性的買盤，而非單一股票帶動的行情。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, on the theory that strong recent performance tends to continue in the short term. Today's buys were chosen because they showed several confirming signals together — rising price, bullish MACD, and healthy RSI — rather than relying on just one indicator.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資（Momentum Investing）是指買入近期表現強勢、股價持續上升的股票，理論基礎是短期內強勢股票的升勢傾向於延續。今天的買入選擇是基於多項訊號同時確認——股價上升、MACD看漲交叉、RSI處於健康區間——而非單靠一個指標作決定。
